question_en:
The EPR spectrum of [B(OMe)3]•− anion radical can be best described as ________
(Given : The natural abundance of 10B is 80%, [I = 3] and that of 11B [I = 3/2] is 20%).
I. 11 lines of equal intensity
II. A set of 4 lines and a set of 7 lines
III. 7 lines with quartets
IV. Two sets of lines with intensity ratio of 160/7
question_gu:
[B(OMe)3]•− anion radicalના EPR spectrumનું યોગ્ય વર્ણન કયું છે? (આપેલ: 10Bની natural abundance 80%, I=3 અને 11Bની I=3/2 સાથે abundance 20% છે.)
I. સમાન intensityની 11 lines
II. 4 linesનો એક set અને 7 linesનો એક set
III. quartets સાથે 7 lines
IV. 160/7 intensity ratio ધરાવતા બે sets of lines
explanation_en: For one boron nucleus, hyperfine splitting gives 2I+1 lines. 10B (I=3) gives 7 lines, while 11B (I=3/2) gives 4 lines. Because both isotopes occur naturally, the spectrum is a set of 7 lines plus a set of 4 lines. Hence II only, option B.
explanation_gu: એક boron nucleus માટે hyperfine linesની સંખ્યા 2I+1 હોય છે. 10B માટે I=3 હોવાથી 7 lines અને 11B માટે I=3/2 હોવાથી 4 lines મળે છે. બંને isotopes natural abundance ધરાવે છે, તેથી 7 અને 4 linesના બે sets મળે છે. એટલે II only, B.
tip_en: Remember EPR hyperfine rule: number of lines = 2I + 1 for one equivalent nucleus.
tip_gu: EPRમાં એક equivalent nucleus માટે lines = 2I+1 યાદ રાખો.
source: Official GSET November 2025 Chemical Sciences Paper-II and official final answer key

question_en:
How many milliliters of 0.20 N K2Cr2O7 are required to titrate 200.0 mL of 0.30 N Fe2+ solution according to the equation given below ?

6Fe2+ + Cr2O7^2− + 14H+ → 6Fe3+ + 2Cr3+ + 7H2O
explanation_en: Use equivalents: N1V1 = N2V2. Fe2+ equivalents = 0.30 × 200.0 = 60.0 mEq. Therefore V(K2Cr2O7) = 60.0/0.20 = 300 mL. Hence D.
explanation_gu: Equivalents માટે N1V1=N2V2. Fe2+ના equivalents = 0.30×200.0 = 60.0 mEq. તેથી K2Cr2O7નું volume = 60.0/0.20 = 300 mL. એટલે D.

question_en:
Isotope dilution method was used to determine iodine content of iodized salt.
To a 10.0 g iodized salt was added radiolabeled 5.0 mg sodium iodide containing 131I (t1/2 = 8 days), with a specific activity of 4.0 × 10^4 cps. After chemical separation 5.0 mg of AgI was separated and it showed specific activity of 2.0 × 10^3 cps. The amount of iodide present in the salt is
question_gu: Iodized saltમાં iodine content નક્કી કરવા isotope dilution method વપરાઈ. 10.0 g iodized saltમાં 131I ધરાવતું 5.0 mg radiolabeled sodium iodide ઉમેરવામાં આવ્યું, specific activity 4.0×10^4 cps હતી. Chemical separation પછી 5.0 mg AgI મળ્યો અને તેની specific activity 2.0×10^3 cps હતી. Saltમાં iodideની માત્રા કેટલી છે?
explanation_en: Specific activity is diluted in proportion to total iodide. Total iodide = 5.0 mg × (4.0×10^4)/(2.0×10^3) = 100 mg. The original iodide in the salt = 100 − 5 = 95 mg. Hence B.
explanation_gu: Specific activity total iodide વધવાથી dilute થાય છે. Total iodide = 5.0×(4.0×10^4)/(2.0×10^3) = 100 mg. તેમાં ઉમેરેલું tracer 5 mg કાઢતાં saltમાં મૂળ iodide = 95 mg. તેથી B.
tip_en: In isotope dilution, specific activity falls inversely with total amount of the labeled element.
tip_gu: Isotope dilutionમાં specific activity total elemental amountના inverse પ્રમાણમાં ઘટે છે.
source: Official GSET November 2025 Chemical Sciences Paper-II and official final answer key

question_en:
Which of the following are the statements for Huckel approximation ?
I. All overlaps are set to zero
II. All diagonal terms are set equal to coulomb integral
III. All resonance integrals between neighbours are set to zero
question_gu:
Hückel approximation માટે નીચેના statementsમાંથી કયા સાચા છે?
I. All overlaps are set to zero
II. All diagonal terms are set equal to Coulomb integral
III. All resonance integrals between neighbours are set to zero
explanation_en: Hückel approximation sets overlap integrals to zero (Sij=0), takes all diagonal Hamiltonian terms as the Coulomb integral α, and retains non-zero resonance integrals β between neighboring atoms. Therefore I and II are correct, while III is false. Hence A.
explanation_gu: Hückel approximationમાં overlap integrals Sij=0 લેવામાં આવે છે અને diagonal Hamiltonian terms α (Coulomb integral) સમાન લેવાય છે. પરંતુ neighbouring atoms વચ્ચે resonance integral β zero નથી; તેને retain કરવામાં આવે છે. તેથી I અને II સાચા છે અને III ખોટું. એટલે A.
tip_en: Hückel: Sij=0, Hii=α, Hij=β for bonded neighbours.
tip_gu: Hückel: Sij=0, Hii=α અને bonded neighbours માટે Hij=β.
source: Official GSET November 2025 Chemical Sciences Paper-II and official final answer key

explanation_gu: 100±0.20 એટલે ±2σ. લગભગ 95.45% measurements ±2σમાં આવે છે, એટલે 50માંથી લગભગ 48.
